    • AUTOMATIC

      public static final HSSFColor.HSSFColorPredefined AUTOMATIC
      Special Default/Normal/Automatic color.

      Note: This class is NOT in the default Map returned by HSSFColor. The index is a special case which is interpreted in the various setXXXColor calls.
